verdicts.reason: A: the 'NEW' badge and the 'Try It' button both sit on top of the shrunken product circle, so three elements collide in one cramped middle cluster. The subcopy is pushed to the far right as a narrow three-line ragged block, which breaks the reading order (headline, then badge/product/CTA, then copy), and the headline wraps awkwardly onto two lines. B: it keeps the original left-to-right structure, clear hierarchy and brand colours, but it is essentially a straight shrink. The subcopy and the 'NEW' pill text are around 5px and barely legible, the product circle is cropped at the top and left edges, and there is dead space between the copy and the badge.
